description_head: Gursimran Khamba presents a brand-new comedy quiz show The Nation Wants To Guess! The first episode features one of India's funniest panels - the original gangsters of comedy - Kenny Sebastian, Jose Covaco and Abish Mathew! They battle it out across chaotic rounds, real-news questions, buzzer wars, applause-for-points and audience sabotage - all to win a ridiculous grand prize!
